scenes: Michael Saylor once lost six billion dollars in a single day.
March twentieth, two thousand. His company, MicroStrategy, admits its earnings were wrong.
Twenty years later, he does something even wilder.
August twenty twenty. MicroStrategy puts two hundred fifty million dollars into Bitcoin.
And it never stops buying. No public company holds more Bitcoin.
Genius, or the same mistake twice?
